include(${PROJECT_DIR}/cmake/cyberdeck_component.cmake)

# The terminus*.c glyph tables are generated by tools/gen_terminus.py from
# the upstream Terminus BDF release and COMMITTED (SIL OFL licensed — see
# their headers + LICENSE). All three sizes are always listed; #if FONT_RT_*
# (and FONT_BOLD_ENABLED) guards inside each file compile the unselected
# ones down to nothing.
cyberdeck_component_register(
    SRCS         font_renderer.c terminus8x16.c terminus10x20.c terminus12x24.c
    INCLUDE_DIRS include
)

if(NOT BUILD_SIMULATOR)
    # The PackBits decoder runs in the bounce ISR; -O2 (over the project's
    # -Os) buys measurable per-glyph decode time for a few hundred bytes.
    set_source_files_properties(font_renderer.c PROPERTIES
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2")
endif()
